title: Camila, 30: The $18,000 Wedding That Cost $36,600

scenes.say: An $18,000 wedding that ends up costing about $36,600. That's Camila's.
She put the whole wedding on credit cards, at about 24% APR.
Her first month's interest alone is about $360.
She pays $450 a month. Only about $90 of it touches the debt.
At $450, it takes almost 7 years to pay off.
Push it to $750 a month, and it's gone in under 3 years.
That's about $11,800 of interest she never pays.
Would you put a wedding on a card? Subscribe so you don't make this mistake on your next paycheck, because an $18,000 wedding can cost $36,600.

question: Would you ever put a wedding on a credit card, or save up first?
description: Camila, 30, put an $18,000 wedding on credit cards at about 24% APR and pays $450 a month. That takes almost 7 years and roughly $36,600 in total. Paying $750 a month clears it in under 3 years and saves around $11,800 in interest. Numbers are rounded US estimates assuming a fixed APR and no new charges.
